title: Crispy Satay Tofu
description: A popular Malaysian dish, this recipe combines the crunch of satay with the simplicity of tofu. A perfect snack for any occasion.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, whisk together coconut milk and satay sauce.
2. Add the tofu cubes to the marinade and toss to coat.
3. Heat 2 tablespoons of peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Remove the tofu from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
5. Fry the tofu until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
6. Remove the tofu from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. In the same skillet, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of peanut oil.
8. Reduce heat to medium and add the crispy rice. Cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted.
9. To serve, place a few pieces of fried tofu on a plate, top with toasted crispy rice, and garnish with chopped peanuts and a lime wedge.
